annotations.title: Two to five agents side by side, from each one’s record

description: Compare 2 to 5 agent addresses side by side on one taxonomy, from the record we keep for every paid address: identity (registered name, ERC-8004 registrations, rails, chains), custom (counterparties, independent payers who were never paid back, payers it also paid, the largest payer’s share, the share who came back), money (received and paid out where priced, x402 payments), work (ACP jobs, completed, completion rate, Olas deliveries) and activity (dealings over 30 and 90 days, first and last paid). Free. Each cell is {state: "read", value, readAt, source} or {state: "unknown", why}; an address with no paid record is a row of unknowns, never zeros. There is no winner and no ranking; `sort` orders by the one figure you name. Independent means no payment back on the rails we read, not proof the payers are different parties.

addresses.description: 2 to 5 agent addresses (EVM, Solana or Cardano), comma-separated.

sort.description: Optional. Orders the rows by that one figure, unknowns last.

name: compare_agents

agents.description: One row per address: `address`, `page` (its aspern.org page), `cells` keyed by field, `readAt` and `says`.

fields.description: The taxonomy in display order: group, key, label.

limits.description: What this comparison does not do.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

readAtSpreadMinutes.description: Minutes between the earliest and latest record in the table; null where no address has a record.

sort.description: Null without a sort key; otherwise `key`, `order`, `unknownLast` and `says`.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
